facts.statement: The genus Eocuculus belongs to the family Cuculidae.
Eocuculus lived between 37 and 27.3 million years ago, during the Priabonian and Rupelian stages.
facts.quote: Time range: Priabonian to Rupelian (37 to 27.3 million years ago)

facts.statement: There are two recorded fossil occurrences of the genus Eocuculus.

rejected.statement: Eocuculus cherpinae is a prehistoric bird known from postcranial fossils found in the late Eocene Florissant beds of Colorado.
rejected.quote: Eocuculus cherpinae is a prehistoric bird, known from postcranial remains from the late Eocene Florissant beds in Colorado.
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'cherpinae is a prehistoric bird known from postcranial'
